text: {"label":"Child Compliance With Instructions","definition":"Assessment and treatment of children's compliance with adult instructions, including high-probability sequences, errorless compliance training, functional analysis of noncompliance, effective instruction delivery, tolerance training, and ethical concerns about assent and autonomy.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centres on following instructions as the target behavior, unlike broad pediatric assessment and treatment, general or residential behavioral intervention programs, and classroom instructional strategies aimed at independent academic responding."}
